admission.justification: A mechanical diff can appear complete after hiding changed intent; compared trees, change counts, bounded decision-record names and a caller-readable complete selected-comparison report make the boundary explicit without implying a semantic verdict.

applicability: Mounted knowledge_diff naming/report answer on a converted memory repository; the dashboard comparison computation remains whole and unchanged.
conditions: A converted memory repository is selected, optionally narrowed by a path or record ID.
The selected comparison is reported before a successful compared answer; a report-write failure refuses with its reason.
The answer carries the compared trees, change counts, decisionRecords within TOOL_ANSWER_LIST_MAX, the total and a report location under the final tool-answer bound.
The report retains the underlying computation, including its per-file patch truncation flags.
exclusions: Inferring a semantic verdict from the mechanical diff.
Canonical database-path comparison, which MIK-R26 retires.
Reinstating inline patches, complete/leftOut or the knowledge_read threshold as this mounted answer promise.
Changing the dashboard or command-line full-result contract.

evidence: test_knowledge_index_surfaces.py bounded and absent-path tests; N13-unbounded-diff.log; N13-absent-path.log; registration/knowledge.py description

statement: Knowledge diff names the two compared trees, counts changes, names decision-asking changed records up to the list bound, and locates a caller-readable report of the selected comparison; absent selectors are refused, and per-file patch cuts are disclosed in the report.
